intro: Altsoba Ragetotem is a tauren weaponsmith stationed at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood. From this remote Horde outpost, he keeps passing champions armed with reliable maces, staves, and axes to face the blighted horrors of the forest.

p: Bloodvenom Post is a treacherous outpost, situated in the heart of Felwood amidst demonic corruption and tainted wildlife. Maintaining a supply line out here is a grim necessity, and Altsoba Ragetotem does his part by outfitting Horde scouts and travelers. Whether someone requires a sturdy crescent axe or a heavy war maul, Altsoba ensures warriors heading into the corrupted timberlands do not enter the fray unarmed.
